what_this_is: Every month from 2010-01 to 2026-08 and what MIW holds for it. A month with no source page is UNKNOWN, never a zero-question sitting.

horizon.rationale: Founder decision. 2010 is the permanent lower boundary of MIW Question Intelligence and 2026-08 the ceiling of this Phase-1 release. Pre-2010 material already held in the repository is ARCHIVE CONTEXT ONLY and may never enter governed recurrence. No pre-2010 acquisition backlog exists or may be created.

zero_denominator_rule: Only NO_EXAM_OFFICIALLY_EVIDENCED may be treated as a confirmed zero-question sitting. Every other non-present state is UNKNOWN and is excluded from recurrence denominators rather than counted as a zero.

coverage_states.SOURCE_PRESENT: A source page or paper is held for this sitting.
coverage_states.NO_SOURCE_PAGE_FOUND: No source page located. Whether a sitting occurred is UNKNOWN.
coverage_states.NO_ARCHIVE_CAPTURE: The source page is known to exist and no archive capture of it was obtained.
coverage_states.SITTING_EXISTS_BUT_QUESTION_SOURCE_UNAVA: Independent evidence says a sitting occurred; its questions are not held.
coverage_states.NO_EXAM_OFFICIALLY_EVIDENCED: An official instrument states no examination was held. Requires an official citation.

calendar_observation.finding: May is absent in every one of the 17 years in the horizon, across all three evidence bands. The 2010-2020 absence rests on one secondary index; the 2021-2026 absence rests on MIW holding its own source copy of every other month and none for May. Two independent lines now agree.
calendar_observation.consequence: These months remain UNKNOWN in the coverage matrix and are excluded from recurrence denominators. They do NOT become confirmed zero-question sittings: that would require an official instrument stating no examination was held, and none is held.

per_month.gap_detail: No May set appears on the source's own index for any year 2010-2019, which is consistent with an ~11-sittings-per-year calendar. That is an inference from one secondary index, not evidence that no examination was held. Recorded as UNKNOWN.
